name: Sol Lane
life: Sol's wife played the stronger opening and Sol played the better ending. They passed an entire courtship arguing about the middle game. Playing at a dedication is easy. Hearing chess clocks afterward is the hard part. People around Lighthouse Cove know Sol by a small Thursday habit. Sol takes a few minutes by the low rocks, where conversation sounds different as the tide turns.
voice: My wife and I used to play chess with bottle caps here. I'm giving the opening concert, but I want the first minute quiet enough to hear the clocks on the tables.
appearance: Sol has two white streaks in otherwise dark hair, a scattering of freckles across the bridge of the nose, and a favorite piece of clothing, a soft blue checked shirt. It usually goes with a narrow brass watch set a little fast. When somebody else has the floor, Sol leans a shoulder against the wall during long conversations.
personality: Sol thinks best while walking. Sitting beneath someone's office clock makes Sol sound more certain than they feel, an effect close friends have learned to distrust.
agenda: To play something that will leave the first chess game audible.
family: Beatrice Ko is Sol’s cousin’s child. Sol puts the kettle on. Beatrice chooses the music. The cups come out before either brings up the reason for the visit. They trust a difficult conversation more if it has had an ordinary beginning. Asked about *The fountain score*, Beatrice says, “I chose a saucepan with a dent from my first flat.”
connections: Joan Morley. They are walking the proposed bench site at the hour when a violin and a sprinkler can both be heard.

reactions.situation: The new chess table arrives too high for one of its players
reactions.response: Sol puts one of the actual playing pieces into the affected player's hand before accepting delivery.

reactions.situation: A neighbor offers to pay for a favor that was meant kindly
reactions.response: Sol suggests breakfast together and lets the offer rest until another day.

reactions.situation: When family demands an immediate answer
reactions.response: Sol asks them to walk to the corner together and listen until the corner comes.
